description: L2-oriented requirement quality rulebook. Generic rules apply to every domain; profiles add domain rules.

rules.title: Atomicity
rules.description: One primary 'shall' per requirement. Split compound requirements into separate IDs.

rules.title: Vague language
rules.description: Avoid undefined vague terms (appropriate, sufficient, fast, robust, minimize, etc.).

rules.title: Acceptance criteria
rules.description: Every requirement needs Given/When/Then acceptance criteria with expected outputs and tolerance.

rules.title: Verification method
rules.description: Every requirement needs a verification method: test, analysis, review, or inspection.

rules.title: Parent trace
rules.description: Software/unit requirements must trace to a parent system/stakeholder requirement.

rules.title: ASIL rationale
rules.description: ASIL-classified requirements need a safety goal/FSR reference or an explicit open issue.

rules.title: Design leakage
rules.description: Requirements state what/why; algorithms, filters, functions and formulas belong in design unless marked as a constraint with rationale.

rules.title: Interface completeness
rules.description: Interface requirements need port, direction, data type, unit, range, resolution and update rate.

rules.title: Timing completeness
rules.description: Timing requirements need trigger, period, deadline/WCET and jitter where applicable.

rules.title: Safety completeness
rules.description: Safety requirements need fault condition, safe state/reaction, debounce and FTTI.

rules.title: Mandatory safety priority
rules.description: A safety requirement cannot be 'should' or 'could'; use 'must' or justify a lower priority.

rules.title: Duplicate ID
rules.description: Requirement IDs must be unique across the set.

rules.title: Test link
rules.description: Every requirement needs at least one test-design ID.

rules.title: Unsupported threshold
rules.description: Numeric thresholds need a rationale or source; otherwise record an open issue.

rules.title: Ambiguous phrase
rules.description: Replace ambiguous phrases with measurable conditions (e.g. 'one control cycle' -> 'within 10 ms').

rules.title: Known conflict
rules.description: Conflicting requirements must be reconciled or recorded with a decision and open issue.

rules.title: Constraint rationale
rules.description: Constraints must state why they are constraints and how they are verified.

rules.title: Normative statement
rules.description: The statement must use a normative 'shall' (or 'shall not').

rules.title: HARA/FSR assumption
rules.description: ASIL values in a synthetic sample are assumptions until a HARA/FSR confirms them.

rules.title: Review status
rules.description: A hardened requirement remains 'review' until a human approves the baseline.
